decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan, Design & Access Statement, Tree Survey, Flood Risk Assessment, TCP-01 Rev. B Received: 18 January 2013 P_02 Rev. C, P_03 Rev. B, P_04 Rev. B, P_05 Rev. B, P_06 Rev. B, P_07 Rev. C, P_08 Rev. C, P_09 Rev. C, P_10 Rev. C Received: 15 March 2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The two storey side extension shall be finished with a white coloured render.
description: Erection of a  two-storey side and rear extension at the property and erection of a further single storey rear extension with reduction of existing front extension to level with front building line and conversion into a study.
